thread:
Ravi: quick QA note - heatmap sampler overlay on the latency dashboard is intercepting scrubber drags on mobile; users can't get the p95 handle when sampler expands.
Lina: yup saw that. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/latency-dashboard-sampler. screenshot attached. tapping the dot often hits the overlay instead of toggling mode.
Ravi: short patch idea: make overlay float (absolute) with higher z-index and not shift the chart; also enlarge hit target to 44px via invisible padding.
Omar: dev concern: floating overlay needs an accessible dismiss and shouldn't trap focus. add `data-overlay` and `aria-hidden` toggles when closed.
Sam: microcopy: current label "Sampling" is ambiguous. options: full "Sampling: Auto — preserves latency targets" compact "Sampling: Auto". for manual/agg modes: "Aggressive — lower fidelity, lower cost".
Lina: accessibility nits: label contrast in dark theme fails for 12px text. bump to 14px or increase weight, or always use high-contrast token.
Omar: CSS sketch for hit area (use transform translate center to avoid layout shifts): `.sampler{width:24px;height:24px;position:relative}.sampler::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%}`
Ravi: action list — 1) float overlay + z-index (Lina) 2) invisible 44px hit area (Omar) 3) focus ring + aria labels + live region announce (Omar) 4) update tooltip copy + narrow variants (Sam) 5) contrast pass in Figma + deliver assets (Lina).
Sam: I'll post copy variants and i18n length notes by EOD.
Omar: I'll open a tiny PR for hit area and keyboard focus; include e2e for focus trap.
Lina: I'll upload contrast pass and add a legend badge for sampling rate (e.g., "10% sampled") so users aren't misled by density.
DesignBot: calendar invite scheduled 2026-03-25 11:00 PT for visual sign-off.
Ravi: thanks all — pausing thread, reopen if blockers.
_meta: Design thread: sampler overlay z-index, hit targets, tooltip copy, heatmap sampling badge, and accessibility fixes for latency observability UI.
